summary.text: COTRN00C is a pseudo-conversational CICS COBOL program (transaction CT00, map COTRN0A in mapset COTRN00) that lists records of the TRANSACT VSAM file ten at a time. On entry without a COMMAREA it transfers to sign-on (COSGN00C); on first entry it lists from the beginning of the file, and on re-entry it dispatches on the attention key: Enter (optional numeric start Tran ID and/or row selection), PF3 (back to menu COMEN01C), PF7 (previous page) and PF8 (next page). Paging uses a STARTBR/READNEXT or READPREV/ENDBR browse keyed on TRAN-ID, keeping the first and last Tran ID shown, the page number and a next-page flag in the CardDemo COMMAREA extension CDEMO-CT00-INFO. Each row shows Tran ID, original date as MM/DD/YY, description and edited amount. Entering 'S' or 's' next to a row stores the Tran ID in CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED and transfers control (XCTL) to the transaction view program COTRN01C. The program only reads TRANSACT; it never updates it.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.logic: Resets the error, EOF, next-page and erase flags and clears the message. With EIBCALEN = 0 it XCTLs to COSGN00C; otherwise it copies DFHCOMMAREA into CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and, on first entry (not CDEMO-PGM-REENTER), sets re-enter, clears the map, performs PROCESS-ENTER-KEY and sends the list. On re-entry it receives the map and dispatches on EIBAID: Enter, PF3 (XCTL to COMEN01C), PF7, PF8, any other key shows CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY. Always ends with CICS RETURN TRANSID CT00 and the COMMAREA.

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-ENTER-KEY
paragraphs.logic: Captures the first non-blank selection field SEL0001I..SEL0010I and its row Tran ID into CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG / CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED. A selection of 'S'/'s' XCTLs to COTRN01C; any other value sets 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S'. Then sets the browse start key TRAN-ID from TRNIDINI (LOW-VALUES when blank, the value when numeric, else error 'Tran ID must be Numeric ...'), resets CDEMO-CT00-PAGE-NUM to 0 and performs PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD.

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-PF7-KEY
paragraphs.logic: Sets TRAN-ID to CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-FIRST (LOW-VALUES when blank) and sets NEXT-PAGE-YES. If CDEMO-CT00-PAGE-NUM > 1 performs PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD, otherwise sends the screen without erase with 'You are already at the top of the page...'.

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-PF8-KEY
paragraphs.logic: Sets TRAN-ID to CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-LAST (HIGH-VALUES when blank). If NEXT-PAGE-YES performs PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD, otherwise sends the screen without erase with 'You are already at the bottom of the page...'.

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD
paragraphs.logic: Starts a browse at TRAN-ID; if no error, skips one record with READNEXT unless the key was Enter/PF7/PF3, clears the 10 rows, then reads up to 10 records into rows 1-10. If more records remain it adds 1 to CDEMO-CT00-PAGE-NUM and reads one extra record to set NEXT-PAGE-YES/NO; otherwise sets NEXT-PAGE-NO and adds 1 to the page only if at least one row was filled. Ends the browse, moves the page number to the map and sends the screen.

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD
paragraphs.logic: Starts a browse at TRAN-ID; if no error, skips one record with READPREV unless the key was Enter/PF8, clears the 10 rows, then reads up to 10 previous records filling rows 10 down to 1. If records remain it reads one more previous record and, when NEXT-PAGE-YES, subtracts 1 from CDEMO-CT00-PAGE-NUM if that read succeeded and the page is > 1, otherwise sets the page to 1. Ends the browse and sends the screen.

paragraphs.name: POPULATE-TRAN-DATA
paragraphs.logic: Formats TRAN-AMT into the edited WS-TRAN-AMT (+99999999.99) and TRAN-ORIG-TS into WS-TRAN-DATE as MM/DD/YY, then moves TRAN-ID, date, TRAN-DESC and amount into row WS-IDX (1-10) of COTRN0AI. Row 1 also saves TRAN-ID in CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-FIRST and row 10 in CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-LAST.

paragraphs.name: INITIALIZE-TRAN-DATA
paragraphs.logic: Moves SPACES to the Tran ID, date, description and amount fields of row WS-IDX (1-10) of COTRN0AI; other index values do nothing.

paragraphs.name: RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN
paragraphs.logic: Defaults CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM to COSGN00C when blank, sets CDEMO-FROM-TRANID/CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM to CT00/COTRN00C, resets CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT to 0 and XCTLs to CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM with the COMMAREA.

paragraphs.name: SEND-TRNLST-SCREEN
paragraphs.logic: Fills the header, moves WS-MESSAGE to ERRMSGO and sends map COTRN0A with ERASE when SEND-ERASE-YES, otherwise without ERASE; cursor placement is requested in both cases.

paragraphs.name: RECEIVE-TRNLST-SCREEN
paragraphs.logic: Receives map COTRN0A into COTRN0AI with RESP/RESP2; the response code is not tested.

paragraphs.name: POPULATE-HEADER-INFO
paragraphs.logic: Moves CURRENT-DATE, titles CCDA-TITLE01/02, transaction CT00 and program name to the header and formats current date as MM/DD/YY and time as HH:MM:SS.

paragraphs.name: STARTBR-TRANSACT-FILE
paragraphs.logic: Issues CICS STARTBR on TRANSACT with RIDFLD TRAN-ID (GTEQ option commented out). NORMAL continues; NOTFND sets TRANSACT-EOF and sends 'You are at the top of the page...'; any other response displays RESP/REAS, sets the error flag and sends 'Unable to lookup transaction...'.

paragraphs.name: READNEXT-TRANSACT-FILE
paragraphs.logic: Issues CICS READNEXT into TRAN-RECORD. NORMAL continues; ENDFILE sets TRANSACT-EOF and sends 'You have reached the bottom of the page...'; other responses set the error flag and send 'Unable to lookup transaction...'.

paragraphs.name: READPREV-TRANSACT-FILE
paragraphs.logic: Issues CICS READPREV into TRAN-RECORD. NORMAL continues; ENDFILE sets TRANSACT-EOF and sends 'You have reached the top of the page...'; other responses set the error flag and send 'Unable to lookup transaction...'.

paragraphs.name: ENDBR-TRANSACT-FILE
paragraphs.logic: Issues CICS ENDBR on TRANSACT without a RESP option.

rules.statement: When the program is started without a COMMAREA (EIBCALEN = 0) the user is sent to the sign-on program COSGN00C instead of the transaction list.

On re-entry the attention key decides the action: Enter processes selection/filter, PF3 returns to the main menu COMEN01C, PF7 pages backward, PF8 pages forward; any other key is rejected with the invalid-key message and the list is redisplayed.
rules.outcome: DFHENTER -> PROCESS-ENTER-KEY; DFHPF3 -> XCTL COMEN01C; DFHPF7 -> PROCESS-PF7-KEY; DFHPF8 -> PROCESS-PF8-KEY; other -> WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY shown.
messages: Invalid key pressed. Please see below...

rules.statement: Only one row selection is honoured per Enter: the selection fields are tested in screen order SEL0001I to SEL0010I and the first non-blank one is taken together with the Tran ID of the same row; if none is filled the stored selection is cleared.
rules.anchor: WHEN SEL0001I OF COTRN0AI NOT = SPACES AND LOW-VALUES
rules.conditions: SELnnnnI not SPACES/LOW-VALUES, evaluated from row 1 to row 10
rules.outcome: CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG = selection value, CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED = TRNIDnnI of that row; otherwise both set to SPACES.

rules.statement: The only valid row selection code is 'S' (upper or lower case). A valid selection on a row with a Tran ID transfers control to the transaction view program COTRN01C with the selected Tran ID in the COMMAREA; any other code is rejected with a message and the list is refreshed.
rules.conditions: CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SEL-FLG and CDEMO-CT00-TRN-SELECTED both not blank; flag = 'S' or 's'
rules.outcome: 'S'/'s': CDEMO-FROM-TRANID = CT00, CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM = COTRN00C, CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT = 0, XCTL COTRN01C. Other: WS-MESSAGE 'Invalid selection. Valid value is S' (error flag not set; list processing continues).
messages: Invalid selection. Valid value is S

rules.statement: The optional start Tran ID entered on the screen must be numeric. Blank means list from the start of the file; a numeric value positions the list at that Tran ID; a non-numeric value is rejected.
rules.anchor: IF TRNIDINI  OF COTRN0AI IS NUMERIC
rules.outcome: Blank: TRAN-ID = LOW-VALUES. Numeric: TRAN-ID = TRNIDINI. Not numeric: WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', message 'Tran ID must be Numeric ...', screen sent.

rules.statement: Every Enter (and the first display) restarts paging: the page number is reset to 0 before the forward page read, so the first page shown is page 1.

PF7 (previous page) is allowed only when the current page number is greater than 1; the backward browse starts at the first Tran ID of the current page (or LOW-VALUES if none is stored). On page 1 the user is told they are already at the top.
rules.outcome: TRAN-ID = CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-FIRST, NEXT-PAGE-YES, PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD; else message 'You are already at the top of the page...' sent without erase.
messages: You are already at the top of the page...

rules.statement: PF8 (next page) is allowed only when the previous forward read found a record beyond the 10 shown (next-page flag 'Y'); the browse starts at the last Tran ID of the current page (HIGH-VALUES if none is stored). Otherwise the user is told they are already at the bottom.
rules.outcome: TRAN-ID = CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-LAST, PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD; else message 'You are already at the bottom of the page...' sent without erase.
messages: You are already at the bottom of the page...

rules.statement: When paging forward with PF8 the record at the start key (the last Tran ID of the previous page) is skipped so it is not repeated; for Enter (filter or first display) the list starts with the record at the start key itself.
rules.anchor: IF EIBAID NOT = DFHENTER AND DFHPF7 AND DFHPF3
rules.conditions: EIBAID not Enter, PF7 or PF3
rules.outcome: One READNEXT is issued and discarded before filling rows.

rules.statement: A page holds at most 10 transactions: the 10 rows are cleared and then filled with up to 10 consecutive TRANSACT records in ascending Tran ID order, stopping early at end of file or on error.
rules.anchor: PERFORM UNTIL WS-IDX >= 11 OR TRANSACT-EOF OR ERR-FLG-ON
rules.conditions: WS-IDX < 11 and not end of file and no error
rules.outcome: Rows 1..n populated via POPULATE-TRAN-DATA; remaining rows blank.

rules.statement: After a forward page fill, the page number is increased by 1 when the page is full and records remain, and a look-ahead read decides whether a next page exists; when end of file was reached during the fill, there is no next page and the page number is increased only if at least one row was shown.
rules.conditions: TRANSACT-NOT-EOF and no error after 10 rows; else WS-IDX > 1
rules.outcome: CDEMO-CT00-PAGE-NUM + 1; NEXT-PAGE-YES if the 11th record exists, otherwise NEXT-PAGE-NO.

rules.statement: When paging backward with PF7 the record at the start key (the first Tran ID of the current page) is skipped, then up to 10 previous records are read in descending Tran ID order and placed from row 10 up to row 1 so the screen remains in ascending order.
rules.anchor: IF EIBAID NOT = DFHENTER AND DFHPF8
rules.conditions: EIBAID not Enter or PF8 for the skip; WS-IDX > 0 and not end of file and no error for the fill
rules.outcome: Rows filled from WS-IDX 10 down to 1.

rules.statement: After a full backward page, a further previous record is read: if it exists and the page number is above 1, the page number is decreased by 1; otherwise the page number is forced to 1. If the backward fill hit the start of the file, the page number is left unchanged.
rules.conditions: TRANSACT-NOT-EOF and no error after the fill, NEXT-PAGE-YES, look-ahead READPREV result, CDEMO-CT00-PAGE-NUM > 1

rules.statement: Each listed transaction shows its original timestamp date reformatted from YYYY-MM-DD to MM/DD/YY and its amount edited with sign and two decimals (+99999999.99).
rules.outcome: WS-TRAN-DATE and WS-TRAN-AMT moved to TDATEnnI / TAMTnnnI.

rules.statement: The Tran ID shown on row 1 is remembered as the page's first key and the Tran ID on row 10 as the page's last key; these keys are the start positions for PF7 and PF8 paging.
rules.outcome: CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-FIRST / CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-LAST updated in the COMMAREA.

rules.statement: Starting the browse: if no record exists at or after the start key the list is treated as at end and the user sees a top-of-page message; any other failure sets the error flag and shows a lookup-failure message, which stops the page fill.
rules.outcome: NOTFND: TRANSACT-EOF, 'You are at the top of the page...'. Other: DISPLAY RESP/REAS, WS-ERR-FLG 'Y', 'Unable to lookup transaction...'.
messages: You are at the top of the page...

rules.statement: Reading forward: end of file stops the list with a bottom-of-page message; any other failure sets the error flag and shows a lookup-failure message.
rules.anchor: 'You have reached the bottom of the page...'
rules.outcome: ENDFILE: TRANSACT-EOF and message. Other: WS-ERR-FLG 'Y' and 'Unable to lookup transaction...'.
messages: You have reached the bottom of the page...

rules.statement: Reading backward: start of file stops the list with a top-of-page message; any other failure sets the error flag and shows a lookup-failure message.
rules.anchor: 'You have reached the top of the page...'
rules.outcome: ENDFILE: TRANSACT-EOF and message. Other: WS-ERR-FLG 'Y' and 'Unable to lookup transaction...'.
messages: You have reached the top of the page...

no_rule_decisions.reason: Row-index EVALUATE that only moves record fields to the screen row WS-IDX (presentation mapping); the first/last key capture is covered by BR-COTRN00C-015.
Row-index EVALUATE that blanks screen row fields (screen housekeeping).
Defensive default of the XCTL target to COSGN00C when CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM is blank (technical fallback).
Chooses SEND with or without ERASE (presentation only).

observations.text: On first entry PROCESS-ENTER-KEY ends with PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD, which already sends the map (line 326), and MAIN-PARA then sends it again, so two SEND MAP commands are issued in the same task.

When the start Tran ID is not numeric, TRAN-ID is not set, the error screen is sent, but processing continues into PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD which still issues STARTBR; because ERR-FLG-ON skips the rest of the paragraph, ENDBR (line 322) is not executed and the browse stays open until task end (Inferred from control flow).

STARTBR NOTFND sets TRANSACT-EOF but not the error flag, so PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD/BACKWARD still perform the skip read (PF8/PF7) and ENDBR on a browse that was never started; ENDBR has no RESP option, so an INVREQ would raise a CICS abend (Inferred from CICS semantics). The NOTFND message 'You are at the top of the page...' is also shown when paging forward from HIGH-VALUES.

STARTBR is coded without GTEQ/EQUAL (GTEQ commented out); positioning therefore relies on the CICS default for STARTBR (Inferred: GTEQ), so a numeric start Tran ID that does not exist lists from the next higher key.

If a backward page reaches the start of file before row 1 is filled, the top rows stay blank, CDEMO-CT00-TRNID-FIRST keeps its previous value (it is only set for WS-IDX = 1) and the page number is not adjusted (Inferred from control flow).
An invalid selection code sets a message but not WS-ERR-FLG, so the list is still re-read and the message is shown with the refreshed page.
Commented-out SET TRANSACT-EOF and PERFORM SEND-TRNLST-SCREEN in the invalid-selection branch.
RECEIVE MAP response codes WS-RESP-CD/WS-REAS-CD are captured but never tested (e.g. MAPFAIL).
ENDBR has no RESP/RESP2, so any error abends the task.
File name 'TRANSACT', transaction 'CT00', program names COSGN00C, COMEN01C and COTRN01C are literals.

The list browses the whole TRANSACT file with no filter on the signed-on user, account or card (CDEMO-USER-ID, CDEMO-USER-TYPE, CDEMO-ACCT-ID are not referenced), so any user who reaches CT00 can see every transaction.

sme_questions.question: Should the transaction list be restricted to the signed-on user's accounts/cards (or to admin users), given that the browse reads every TRANSACT record?
Is the start Tran ID meant to be an exact match or a 'start at or after' position? STARTBR is coded without GTEQ (commented out).
Is the page number expected to remain accurate when a backward page reaches the beginning of the file with fewer than 10 records, and should the browse be ended when the start Tran ID is invalid?
